AcceptHandshake.description_zh: 被邀请的阿里云账号调用AcceptHandshake接受邀请

AttachPolicy.description_en: Attaches a permission policy to an object, which can be a RAM user, RAM user group, or RAM role. After you attach a permission policy to an object, the object has the operation permissions on the resources in a specific resource group or within a specific Alibaba Cloud account
AttachPolicy.description_zh: 调用AttachPolicy为授权对象（RAM用户、RAM用户组或RAM角色）添加权限策略，即授权。完成授权后，被授权对象将获得指定资源组或阿里云账号内资源的访问权限

BindSecureMobilePhone.description_en: Binds a mobile phone number to a member of the resource account type in a resource directory for security purposes
BindSecureMobilePhone.description_zh: 调用BindSecureMobilePhone为资源账号类型的成员设置安全手机号码

CancelChangeAccountEmail.description_en: Cancels the email address change of a member
CancelChangeAccountEmail.description_zh: 调用CancelChangeAccountEmail取消修改成员邮箱

CancelCreateCloudAccount.description_en: Cancels the creation of a cloud account
CancelCreateCloudAccount.description_zh: 取消创建资源目录云账号类型的成员

CancelPromoteResourceAccount.description_en: Cancels the upgrade from a resource account to a cloud account
CancelPromoteResourceAccount.description_zh: 取消升级资源目录资源账号为云账号

ChangeAccountEmail.description_en: Changes the email address that is bound to a member

CheckAccountDelete.description_zh: 调用CheckAccountDelete执行成员删除检查任务

CreateAutoGroupingRule.description_en: Creates an automatic resource group transfer rule. Two types are supported: custom transfer rules and attached-resource transfer rules
CreateAutoGroupingRule.description_zh: 调用CreateAutoGroupingRule创建自动转组规则。支持自定义转组规则和关联资源跟随转组规则两类

CreateCloudAccount.description_en: Creates a member of the cloud account type in a resource directory
CreateCloudAccount.description_zh: 创建资源目录云账号类型的成员

CreateControlPolicy.description_en: Calls CreateControlPolicy to create a custom control policy
CreateControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用CreateControlPolicy创建自定义管控策略

CreateFolder.description_en: Creates a resource folder by calling CreateFolder

CreatePolicy.description_zh: 调用CreatePolicy创建一个权限策略

CreatePolicyVersion.description_en: Creates a version of an access policy by calling CreatePolicyVersion
CreatePolicyVersion.description_zh: 调用CreatePolicyVersion创建权限策略版本

CreateResourceAccount.description_en: Creates a member of the resource account type
CreateResourceAccount.description_zh: 调用CreateResourceAccount创建资源账号类型的成员

CreateRole.description_en: Creates a role by calling CreateRole

CreateServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 调用CreateServiceLinkedRole创建服务关联角色

DeclineHandshake.description_en: Declines a handshake invitation by the invited Alibaba Cloud account
DeclineHandshake.description_zh: 被邀请的阿里云账号调用DeclineHandshake拒绝邀请

DeleteAccount.description_en: Deletes a member of the resource account type
DeleteAccount.description_zh: 调用DeleteAccount删除资源类型的成员

DeleteAutoGroupingRule.description_zh: 调用DeleteAutoGroupingRule删除自动转组规则

DeleteControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteControlPolicy删除自定义管控策略

DeletePolicy.description_zh: 调用DeletePolicy删除指定的权限策略

DeletePolicyVersion.description_en: Deletes a version of a permission policy
DeletePolicyVersion.description_zh: 调用DeletePolicyVersion删除权限策略版本

DeleteServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 调用DeleteServiceLinkedRole删除服务关联角色

DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator.description_en: Removes a delegated administrator account for a trusted service
DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator.description_zh: 调用DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator移除可信服务的委派管理员账号

DestroyResourceDirectory.description_en: Disables a resource directory. This operation cannot be undone. Therefore, exercise caution when you perform it
DestroyResourceDirectory.description_zh: 调用DestroyResourceDirectory关闭资源目录。此操作不可恢复，请您慎重操作

DetachPolicy.description_en: Detaches a permission policy from an object. After you detach a policy from an object, the object does not have the operation permissions on the current resource group or the resources within the current account
DetachPolicy.description_zh: 调用DetachPolicy移除指定对象的权限策略。移除授权后，该对象将失去对当前资源组或账号中资源的操作权限

DisableAssociatedTransfer.description_en: Disables the Transfer Associated Resources feature
DisableAssociatedTransfer.description_zh: 调用DisableAssociatedTransfer关闭关联资源跟随转组功能

DisableAutoGrouping.description_en: Disables the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. After the feature is disabled, existing custom transfer rules and existing transfer rules for associated resources are deleted. However, existing relationships between resources and resource groups are not affected. If you still want to use this feature, you can enable it again 1 minute later
DisableAutoGrouping.description_zh: 调用DisableAutoGrouping关闭自动转组。关闭自动转组功能后，已设置的自定义条件规则、关联资源跟随转组规则将会被删除，存量资源所属资源组不受影响。如您需要，您也可以在关闭自动转组功能1分钟后，重新开启该功能

DisableControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用DisableControlPolicy关闭管控策略功能

EnableAssociatedTransfer.description_en: Enables the Transfer Associated Resources feature
EnableAssociatedTransfer.description_zh: 调用EnableAssociatedTransfer开通关联资源跟随转组功能

EnableAutoGrouping.description_en: Enables the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. After the feature is enabled, you can create, update, delete, and query transfer rules
EnableAutoGrouping.description_zh: 调用EnableAutoGrouping开通自动转组。开通后可以创建、更新、删除、查询自动转组规则

EnableControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用EnableControlPolicy开启管控策略功能

GetAccount.description_en: Calls GetAccount to retrieve member account information

GetAccountDeletionCheckResult.description_en: Queries the result of a member deletion check
GetAccountDeletionCheckResult.description_zh: 调用GetAccountDeletionCheckResult查询成员删除检查结果

GetAccountDeletionStatus.description_en: Queries the deletion status of a member account
GetAccountDeletionStatus.description_zh: 调用GetAccountDeletionStatus查询成员删除状态

GetAutoGroupingRule.description_en: Queries the information about an automatic resource group transfer rule
GetAutoGroupingRule.description_zh: 调用GetAutoGroupingRule查询自动转组规则信息

GetAutoGroupingStatus.description_en: Queries the status of the Automatic Resource Transfer feature
GetAutoGroupingStatus.description_zh: 调用GetAutoGroupingStatus查询自动转组设置状态

GetControlPolicy.description_en: Queries the details of a control policy by calling GetControlPolicy
GetControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用GetControlPolicy查询管控策略的详情

GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus.description_en: Queries the status of the Control Policy feature
GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus.description_zh: 调用GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus查询管控策略功能的开启或关闭状态

GetFolder.description_en: Calls GetFolder to retrieve the information about a folder

GetHandshake.description_en: Queries the information of an invitation

GetPayerForAccount.description_en: Queries the information of a settlement account
GetPayerForAccount.description_zh: 调用GetPayerForAccount获取成员的结算账号信息

GetPolicy.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified access policy
GetPolicy.description_zh: 调用GetPolicy获取指定的权限策略信息

GetPolicyVersion.description_en: Retrieves a version of an access policy
GetPolicyVersion.description_zh: 调用GetPolicyVersion获取某个权限策略的版本

GetResourceDirectory.description_en: Queries the information about a resource directory. If the management account calls this operation, the details of the resource directory enabled by the management account are returned. If a member calls this operation, the details of the resource directory to which the member belongs are returned
GetResourceDirectory.description_zh: 调用GetResourceDirectory获取资源目录信息。管理账号调用时，返回管理账号开通的资源目录详情。成员调用时，返回成员所属的资源目录详情

GetResourceGroup.description_en: Queries the information of a resource group

GetResourceGroupAdminSetting.description_en: Queries the configurations of a resource group administrator
GetResourceGroupAdminSetting.description_zh: 调用GetResourceGroupAdminSetting查询资源组管理员配置

GetResourceGroupNotificationSetting.description_en: Queries the notification settings of a resource group

GetResourceGroupResourceCounts.description_en: Queries the number of resources in a visible resource group
GetResourceGroupResourceCounts.description_zh: 查询可见资源组下的资源数量

GetRole.description_en: Queries the information about a role by calling GetRole

GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus.description_en: Queries the status of the task that is used to delete a service-linked role
GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus.description_zh: 调用GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus获取删除服务关联角色的任务状态

InitResourceDirectory.description_en: Calls InitResourceDirectory to enable a resource directory. After you enable a resource directory, the system creates a Root folder and sets the current account as the management account. The management account has all permissions to manage the resource directory
InitResourceDirectory.description_zh: 调用InitResourceDirectory开通资源目录。开通资源目录后，系统会为您创建一个Root资源夹，并将当前账号设置为企业管理账号。该企业管理账号具有管理资源目录的所有权限

InviteAccountToResourceDirectory.description_en: Invites an account to join a resource directory
InviteAccountToResourceDirectory.description_zh: 调用InviteAccountToResourceDirectory邀请外部账号加入资源目录

ListAccounts.description_en: Queries all the members in a resource directory
ListAccounts.description_zh: 调用ListAccounts查询整个资源目录下的所有成员列表

ListAccountsForParent.description_en: Queries the information of members in a folder
ListAccountsForParent.description_zh: 调用ListAccountsForParent查询资源夹下的成员列表

ListAncestors.description_en: Queries information about all parent folders of a specified folder. The results are displayed in order from top to bottom
ListAncestors.description_zh: 调用ListAncestors查看指定资源夹的所有父资源夹信息。返回结果将按照从上到下的顺序展示资源夹信息

ListAssociatedTransferSetting.description_en: Queries the settings of the Transfer Associated Resources feature
ListAssociatedTransferSetting.description_zh: 调用ListAssociatedTransferSetting获取关联转组功能设置

ListAutoGroupingRemediations.description_zh: 调用ListAutoGroupingRemediations列出自动分组修正记录

ListAutoGroupingRules.description_en: Queries the list of automatic group transfer rules
ListAutoGroupingRules.description_zh: 调用ListAutoGroupingRules查询自动转组规则列表

ListControlPolicies.description_en: Queries the list of control policies
ListControlPolicies.description_zh: 调用ListControlPolicies查询管控策略列表

ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget.description_en: Queries the list of control policies attached to a resource folder or member account
ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget.description_zh: 调用ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget查询资源夹或成员账号绑定的管控策略列表

ListDelegatedAdministrators.description_zh: 调用ListDelegatedAdministrators查询可信服务的委派管理员账号列表

ListDelegatedServicesForAccount.description_en: Queries the trusted services for which a member is specified as a delegated administrator account
ListDelegatedServicesForAccount.description_zh: 调用ListDelegatedServicesForAccount查询指定成员被设置为哪些可信服务的委派管理员账号

ListFoldersForParent.description_en: Queries the subfolders of a specified folder
ListFoldersForParent.description_zh: 调用ListFoldersForParent查询指定资源夹的子资源夹列表

ListHandshakesForAccount.description_en: Queries the invitations that are associated with an account
ListHandshakesForAccount.description_zh: 调用ListHandshakesForAccount查询当前账号下的邀请记录

ListHandshakesForResourceDirectory.description_en: Queries invitations in a resource directory
ListHandshakesForResourceDirectory.description_zh: 调用ListHandshakesForResourceDirectory查看资源目录下的所有邀请列表

ListPolicies.description_en: Calls ListPolicies to query a list of access policies
ListPolicies.description_zh: 调用ListPolicies查看权限策略列表

ListPolicyAttachments.description_en: Queries the list of policy attachments by calling ListPolicyAttachments

ListPolicyVersions.description_en: Queries the versions of an access policy
ListPolicyVersions.description_zh: 调用ListPolicyVersions查看权限策略版本列表

ListResourceGroups.description_en: Invoke ListResourceGroups to query the list of resource groups

ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails.description_en: Queries resource groups and their user authorization information
ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails.description_zh: 调用ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails列出资源组与用户授权信息

ListResources.description_en: Queries resources that can be accessed by the current account in resource groups
ListResources.description_zh: 调用ListResources查询当前账号可以访问的资源组中的资源列表

ListRoles.description_en: Queries the list of roles by calling ListRoles

ListTagKeys.description_zh: 调用ListTagKeys查询资源目录成员的标签键列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are added to resource groups or the members in a resource directory
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询资源组或资源目录成员绑定的标签列表

ListTagValues.description_en: Queries the tag values of a tag key
ListTagValues.description_zh: 调用ListTagValues查询指定标签键对应的标签值

ListTargetAttachmentsForControlPolicy.description_en: Queries the nodes to which a control policy is attached
ListTargetAttachmentsForControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用ListTargetAttachmentsForControlPolicy查询管控策略绑定的节点

ListTrustedServiceStatus.description_en: Queries the list of trusted services enabled by the management account or a delegated administrator account
ListTrustedServiceStatus.description_zh: 调用ListTrustedServiceStatus查询管理账号或委派管理员账号已启用的可信服务列表

MoveAccount.description_en: Moves a member account from a folder to another
MoveAccount.description_zh: 调用MoveAccount将成员移动到另一个资源夹

MoveResources.description_en: Moves resources from one resource group to another. You can move multiple resources that reside in different regions, are used by different Alibaba Cloud services, or belong to different resource groups
MoveResources.description_zh: 调用MoveResources将资源从一个资源组转移到另一个资源组

PromoteResourceAccount.description_en: Upgrades a resource account to an Alibaba Cloud account. This is an asynchronous operation
PromoteResourceAccount.description_zh: 将资源账号升级为云账号，异步操作

RegisterDelegatedAdministrator.description_en: Specifies a member in a resource directory as a delegated administrator account of a trusted service
RegisterDelegatedAdministrator.description_zh: 调用RegisterDelegatedAdministrator将资源目录的成员账号设置为可信服务的委派管理员账号

RemoveCloudAccount.description_en: Removes a member of the cloud account type. After you remove a member of the cloud account type, the member is no longer managed by the management account of the resource directory to which the member belonged
RemoveCloudAccount.description_zh: 调用RemoveCloudAccount移除云账号类型的成员。移除后，该成员将作为独立的阿里云账号存在，不再被资源目录的管理账号管控

ResendCreateCloudAccountEmail.description_en: Resends the confirmation email for creating a cloud account
ResendCreateCloudAccountEmail.description_zh: 重新发送创建云账号的确认邮件

ResendPromoteResourceAccountEmail.description_en: Resends the confirmation email for upgrading a resource account to a cloud account
ResendPromoteResourceAccountEmail.description_zh: 重新发送资源账号升级为云账号的确认邮件

RetryChangeAccountEmail.description_en: Resends a verification email for the email address change of a member
RetryChangeAccountEmail.description_zh: 调用RetryChangeAccountEmail重新发送修改成员邮箱的确认邮件

SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobileP.description_en: Sends a verification code to a secure phone number when you set the secure phone number for a member of the resource account type by calling SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone
SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobileP.description_zh: 为资源账号类型的成员设置安全手机号码时，调用SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone向安全手机发送验证码

SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD.description_en: Sends a verification code to the mobile phone number bound to a newly created account when you use the account to enable a resource directory
SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD.description_zh: 通过创建新管理账号开通资源目录时，调用 SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD 向新管理账号的安全手机号码发送验证码

SetDefaultPolicyVersion.description_en: Sets a default version for a permission policy
SetDefaultPolicyVersion.description_zh: 调用SetDefaultPolicyVersion设置权限策略默认版本

SetMemberDeletionPermission.description_en: Enables or disables the member deletion feature
SetMemberDeletionPermission.description_zh: 调用SetMemberDeletionPermission开启或关闭成员删除许可

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to resource groups or the members in a resource directory
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources为资源组或资源目录的成员绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from resource groups or the members in a resource directory
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources解绑资源组或资源目成员的标签

UpdateAccount.description_en: Changes the display name of a member, or switches the type of a member
UpdateAccount.description_zh: 调用UpdateAccount修改成员名称或切换成员类型

UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting.description_en: Updates the settings of the associated resource group transfer feature by calling UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting
UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting.description_zh: 调用UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting更新关联转组功能设置

UpdateAutoGroupingConfig.description_en: Updates the configuration of the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. You can update only the configuration of the Transfer Existing Associated Resources feature
UpdateAutoGroupingConfig.description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoGroupingConfig更新自动转组设置。目前仅支持设置是否开启存量关联资源跟随转组任务

UpdateAutoGroupingRule.description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoGroupingRule更新自动转组规则

UpdateControlPolicy.description_en: Modifies a custom control policy by calling UpdateControlPolicy
UpdateControlPolicy.description_zh: 调用UpdateControlPolicy修改自定义管控策略

UpdateFolder.description_en: Modifies the name of a folder by calling UpdateFolder

UpdateResourceGroup.description_en: Updates the basic information of a resource group
UpdateResourceGroup.description_zh: 调用UpdateResourceGroup修改资源组的显示名称

UpdateResourceGroupAdminSetting.description_en: Updates the configurations of a resource group administrator
UpdateResourceGroupAdminSetting.description_zh: 调用UpdateResourceGroupAdminSetting更新资源组管理员配置

UpdateRole.description_en: Updates the information of a RAM role
